topic: Project lifecycle: 2014 state grant, 2015 sponsor shelving, presumed cancellation
wiki_text: In September 2014 Finland's Ministry of Employment and the Economy awarded Oy Aga Ab (a subsidiary of AGA, which rebranded to Linde in 2020) EUR 8,619,200 toward construction of a small LNG import terminal in the Port of Rauma (eight tanks, ~10,000 m3 combined storage), with completion targeted for early 2017. On 21 August 2015, YLE reported (citing Satakunnan Kansa) that AGA had shelved ('hyllytti') the Rauma LNG investment, with project manager Pasi Moisio attributing the freeze to lower oil prices and changed price ratios among energy raw materials. The terminal was never built; with no project activity for several years it is presumed cancelled.
